identitySignals: The agenda names The Regents of the University of California (UC Cooperative Extension, Alameda County), and the agreement title names UC Agriculture and Natural Resources (UC ANR) and its UC Cooperative Extension - Alameda County, which matches the public UC Cooperative Extension county-office system run by UC ANR (Legislative Analyst's Office report)

UC Cooperative Extension Alameda County is a listed public UC outreach office serving Alameda County, which includes Oakland, matching the agenda's Oakland, CA location (California Land Conservation Assistance Network listing)

Search results for UC ANR's Alameda County site describe UC Cooperative Extension Alameda County working with Oakland Unified School District garden and nutrition education programs, matching the 'Student health, support & family services' purpose

profile.summary: UC Cooperative Extension, Alameda County is the local office of the University of California's Agriculture and Natural Resources division. UC Cooperative Extension offices bring University of California research and educational resources to communities through outreach, in areas such as food, nutrition, gardening and the environment.
